- Source decision: six additional public community routes were screened: SpaceBattles Story Ideas & Recommendations, SpaceBattles Creative Library, Sufficient Velocity Story Library, Sufficient Velocity Creative Discussion & Worldbuilding, Tapas Writing | Novels, and the 2026-09-07 r/rational Monday Request and Recommendation Thread. SpaceBattles Story Ideas & Recommendations and r/rational passed as bounded link-only additions. SpaceBattles Creative Library was deferred to avoid same-platform route duplication before reader value is demonstrated; Sufficient Velocity Story Library was deferred because its catalog role needs distinct value from existing discovery sources; Sufficient Velocity Creative Discussion & Worldbuilding was deferred because it is creator/worldbuilding oriented rather than a dedicated reader recommendation queue; Tapas Writing | Novels was deferred because the surface mixes writing discussion, feedback, self-promotion, and reader requests.

The portfolio therefore remains at 25 maintained source families. No community post body, comment, username, vote count, rating, story text, account state, or private data was copied; no community API, login, crawler, CAPTCHA bypass, or background synchronization was introduced.
- Community decision: the new routes are first-party public destinations with date-stamped WebNR editorial labels. The cycle does not infer population-wide preferences from a small post sample and performs no automated account action, unsolicited promotion, outreach, or backlink request.
- Search decision: the new guide uses a direct-answer title, stable date/slug, concrete recommendation-task language, and a related link to the August Discussion Radar. The exact generated documentation artifact contains the `www.webnovel.win` canonical URL, includes the new URL in the sitemap, and preserves the single GA4 destination with full-URL page-view fields. A bounded off-site search sample found no verified external WebNR mention; this is a sampled observation, not a claim that no external mention exists anywhere.

The Cloudflare connector exposed a multi-account credential scope without a safely resolvable exact account ID for this zone in the operating context; no account ID was guessed, so request analytics remain unavailable rather than zero.
